title: Existence of the strong monoidal section-module equivalence
statement: Let C be a category with Grothendieck topology J, with objects and morphisms bounded by the coefficient universe w. Assume abelian sheafification exists and its local equivalences are monoidal. For any commutative monoid object R of abelian sheaves, the section-module equivalence of lem-pe-internal-section-tensor-comparison admits a strong monoidal structure. This is an existence statement for the specified equivalence, with no extra hypothesis on R or on objects of C.

source.place: Tags 03EK and 0GMW; coherent normalized section tensor comparison lem-pe-internal-section-tensor-comparison, used in step 6 of lem-ctf-finite-comparison-presentation.

proof.text: Take the normalized tensor and unit isomorphisms and the naturality, associativity and both unit coherence equations from internal_section_tensor_comparison. The equations are valid also for the zero ring and for an empty site: no element or point is chosen.

Apply Mathlib Functor.CoreMonoidal.mk' to the inverse unit and tensor isomorphisms. Obtain the two separate tensor naturality identities from the given joint naturality by substituting identity maps. Cancel the left and right unitors to derive the core unit equations from the given unit coherence. Convert the core structure to Functor.Monoidal and take its Nonempty witness.

theorem sectionMonoidal_exists
    {C : Type c} [Category.{h} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [UnivLE.{max c h, w}] [HasSheafify J Ab.{w}]
    [(J.W (A := Ab.{w})).IsMonoidal]
    (R : Sheaf J Ab.{w}) [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R] :
    Nonempty (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionModuleEquivalence J R).functor.Monoidal
